description.value: Chateau Riverside Boutique Hotel is a boutique vacation rental situated beside the Campbell River in Campbell River, BC, with north-facing suites offering views of the water and local wildlife including seals. The property offers fully self-contained apartment-style suites from one to two bedrooms, each featuring a full kitchen, heat pump, in-suite sauna, and 50" flat-screen TV — designed for extended, self-catered stays with a home-away-from-home atmosphere. Its riverside location on northern Vancouver Island provides a tranquil base for touring cyclists exploring the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an actively operating vacation rental accommodation in Campbell River, BC; the ©2026 copyright and detailed current content confirm it is open. Contact details largely match OSM — the phone number is the same, but the website consistently lists both '1810, 1820 19th Avenue' while OSM records only '1810', suggesting the property spans two adjacent units. The website confirms free high-speed Wi-Fi (300mbps) and in-suite laundry in select units, but contains no mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific facilities.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records only '1810 19th Avenue' but the website consistently lists '1810, 1820 19th Avenue' — the property appears to span two adjacent units or buildings.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating boutique hotel in Campbell River with a fully functional website, confirmed contact details, and detailed room listings. A legitimate accommodation option for touring cyclists on northern Vancouver Island.

Laundry.detail: Website states 'two units equipped with laundry machines'; Comfort room listing confirms 'In Suite Washer & Dryer'

Nearby evening food.detail: Dining page lists extensive nearby pubs, restaurants, and fine dining with walking/driving times, including Riptide Marine Pub (5 min drive), Beach Fire Brewing and Nosh House (6 min), and multiple other dinner options
